correctness.rationale: Over F2, graph incidence B has rank m−1 and kernel {0,z}, z the unique cycle indicator. Edge-cube walk Y_t lives in fixed parity layer P_t and vertex walk is BY_t. If cycle length ℓ odd, B restricted to P_t is bijective, preserving exact finite-time TV and χ² to full stationary uniform even-vertex group. If ℓ even, parity-preserving z makes map two-to-one onto the reachable periodic class. For t=floor((m/4)log m+cm), √m(1−2/m)^t→s=e^(−2c); Walsh coefficients (1−2k/m)^t have parity-complement symmetry and L²-summable binomial bounds, giving parity-conditioned product Bernoulli density approximation. Normal approximations give odd lognormal TV 2Φ(s/2)−1 and χ² e^{s²}−1; averaging product likelihood over y and y+z gives exp(−s²/2+s√(1−α)Z1)cosh(s√α Z2), with χ²=[e^{s²}+e^{(1−2α)s²}]/2−1. Distinction between current parity-class and full equilibrium is mathematically necessary, not a technicality. Finite enumerator source tests m=3..8 and the incidence/spectral identities; it does not prove asymptotics.
